physical_state_in: Atmospheric moisture over 801463 km2 catchment and Alpine/Carpathian snowpack
physical_state_out: Surface runoff groundwater recharge and tributary baseflow entering the mainstem
primary_transformation: Precipitation interception; snowmelt; evapotranspiration; soil infiltration; groundwater contribution
typical_time_scale: Sub-daily storms; seasonal snowmelt; multi-year groundwater
measurable_output: Mean annual discharge (m3/s); seasonal flow hydrograph; groundwater contribution ratio
D_parameters: WFD environmental flow requirements; EU Floods Directive minimum ecological flow standards; Ramsar water level targets
C_parameters: Mean annual discharge delivered to mainstem; seasonal hydrograph; groundwater contribution fraction
notes: 6500 m3/s mean at delta; 206 km3/yr; 35% Alpine; 40% Carpathian; 25% groundwater. Climate change shortening snowmelt timing by 2-3 weeks.

physical_state_in: Individual tributary flows entering the Danube mainstem
physical_state_out: Accumulated mainstem discharge with combined nutrient and sediment and pollutant loads from all tributaries
primary_transformation: Hydraulic confluence; mixing of tributary water quality; flow routing through reservoirs and floodplains
typical_time_scale: Days to weeks flood waves; seasonal hydrograph
measurable_output: Cumulative discharge at Bratislava Budapest Iron Gate and delta gauging stations (m3/s)
D_parameters: Tributary flow sharing agreements; ICPDR data sharing protocols; national monitoring standards
C_parameters: Cumulative discharge at key gauging stations; tributary contribution fractions; water quality integration
notes: 350 m3/s Kelheim to 6500 m3/s delta; 7 major tributaries; 75% of flow from tributaries. Data quality High EU states; Medium Serbia/Moldova/Ukraine.

physical_state_in: Accumulated mainstem flow entering engineered and natural channel reaches
physical_state_out: Functionally differentiated channel: gravel bars pools riffles and side-arms providing habitat diversity
primary_transformation: Bedload transport; channel migration; lateral erosion; gravel bar formation; side-arm connectivity
typical_time_scale: Years to decades morphological change; seasonal gravel bar dynamics
measurable_output: Hydromorphological status score (WFD 1-5); side-arm connectivity index; gravel bar area (km2)
output_unit: WFD score; connectivity index 0-1; km2 gravel bars
D_parameters: WFD Good Ecological Potential obligations; Habitats Directive Article 6 for protected reaches; navigation maintenance requirements
C_parameters: Hydromorphological WFD score; side-arm connectivity; gravel bar area; channel sinuosity
notes: Only 18% of mainstream at WFD good ecological status; 80% channelised; side-arm connectivity 0.22; 77% gravel bars lost. PRIMARY BOTTLENECK (72%).

physical_state_in: Flowing water carrying suspended sediment and bedload from catchment sources
physical_state_out: Downstream sediment delivery to delta; geomorphic work (bar formation; channel incision; delta building)
primary_transformation: Suspended load transport; bedload transport; channel bed incision; gravel bar dynamics; delta accretion
measurable_output: Annual sediment flux (Mt/yr); channel bed incision rate (mm/yr); delta accretion/subsidence (mm/yr)
output_unit: Mt/yr; mm/yr bed incision; mm/yr delta
D_parameters: ICPDR Sediment Management Framework obligations; WFD geomorphological elements assessment requirements
C_parameters: Sediment flux to delta; channel bed stability; delta net accretion/subsidence balance
notes: 17 Mt/yr to delta (was 40 Mt; -57% from Iron Gate); 8 mm/yr channel incision; delta subsiding 3.7 mm/yr net. Permanent structural deficit. PRIMARY BOTTLENECK (72%).

phase_name: Flow Delivery to Delta and Black Sea
physical_state_in: Mainstem flow entering the Danube Delta distributary network
physical_state_out: Fresh water nutrient and residual sediment delivered to delta wetlands and coastal zone and Black Sea
primary_transformation: Flow distribution across three arms; mixing with Black Sea coastal zone; nutrient delivery to marine shelf
typical_time_scale: Annual flow cycle; seasonal nutrient pulses
measurable_output: Annual freshwater delivery to Black Sea (km3/yr); nutrient load (kt N P/yr); salinity intrusion length (km)
D_parameters: Black Sea Commission nutrient reduction targets; DDBRA Biosphere Reserve water level management; EU MSFD marine objectives
C_parameters: Freshwater delivered to Black Sea annually; nutrient loads; salinity intrusion extent; delta ecosystem support
notes: 195 km3/yr to Black Sea; 380 kt N/yr; 12 kt P/yr; Chilia arm 58% of flow; Sulina 21%; Sfantu Gheorghe 21%.
